searchText: It also seems that Polygon plans to have MATIC blockchain as a mainchain on their network, then add rollups over it. It looks more like marketing, to claim they're gonna support any kind of tech that arises. But maybe they claim to be a sidechain because they support EVM and to call attention from services that are struggling on ETH and don't wanna port to other technology, but in fact they are developing a separated network as Binance is. that is just a centralized bridge though isnt it? so would be the same as any other evm clone chain yes so i would argue they are all considered sidechains, or none are could even say the same for tron but nobody cares about them anymore <:kek:807419463565180969> I hope so 😄 is there any ZK live? or are they all on test yet? I see Optimism is finally live, they have Uniswap and Synthetix with almost 10 tokens available zksync has been live for over a year, although it's relatively limited and doesn't have proper evm support what's their URL? what services are running on them? I heard they were going to turn matic *into* some kind of rollup https://zksync.io/ there's a few exchanges that apparently support withdrawals onto their rollup, and they support minting NFTs and some other things on it "zkevm" support is coming "soon™️" with zksync 2.0 it seems very interesting, they should list services running on their system I mean there's a big list of logos on the website but also, it's free software they have no way of knowing unless someone tells them I think those logo are of groups that pointed will use them, not those live with so many networks around, their main site should make some effort to list services that are actually running so, ZkSync and Optimistic are live, and I don't see any info on them for running nodes or validation for their systems zksync is "centralized" at the moment but they only have the power to censor txs, not sure about optimism though go tell them to do that lol yeah 😄 what kind of L2 is Immutable X? I don't know but does the new loopring L2 NFT capability do the job of immutable x?
